name: Aureka Limited
summary: Aureka Limited engages in the mineral exploration business in Australia. It primarily produces gold, and silver deposits. The company’s flagship project owned 100% interests in the Stawell Corridor gold project located in North-West of Melbourne, Victoria. The company was formerly known as Navarre Minerals Limited and changed its name to Aureka Limited in December 2024. Aureka Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Melbourne, Australia.
